title: ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection
authors_zh: Tao Liu, Taiqiang Wu, Runming Yang, Shaoning Sun, Junjie Wang, Yujiu Yang
paper_type_zh: 概率引导的词元级监督微调研究
best_for_zh: 设计推理导向监督微调词元选择或掩码的读者。
one_line: ProFit masks low-probability reference tokens during SFT so high-probability semantic anchors dominate the training signal.
ProFit 在监督微调中屏蔽低概率参考词元，使高概率语义锚点主导训练信号。
why: It makes the token-level boundary of the SFT supervision record explicit.
inclusion_reason: It changes which tokens within retained SFT records are consumed by the training objective and evaluates the effect on a later RL consumer.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Single-reference SFT forces a model to imitate every token of one answer even though many surface expressions are interchangeable. Collecting multiple valid references can reduce that overfitting, but it multiplies data construction and training cost. Sample-level selection cannot distinguish the logical core of a response from stylistic or low-information segments inside the same response.

This paper asks whether one reference answer can be turned into a more selective supervision signal without building a multi-answer dataset. The training object is an instruction-response pair together with the current model's probability for every reference token. The decision is which token losses are allowed to update the SFT model; it is not a claim that low-probability text is globally incorrect or that probability alone verifies an answer.

单参考答案监督微调迫使模型模仿一个答案的每个词元，尽管许多表面表达可以互换。收集多个有效参考答案可以减少这种过拟合，却会成倍增加数据构造和训练成本。样本级选择无法区分同一回复内部的逻辑核心与风格性或低信息片段。

本文追问能否不构造多答案数据集，就把一个参考答案变成更有选择性的监督信号。训练对象是指令—回复对，以及当前模型为每个参考词元给出的概率。决策是哪些词元损失被允许更新监督微调模型；它不声称低概率文本全局错误，也不声称概率本身验证答案。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ProFit assumes that, for the logic-heavy tasks it studies, high-probability reference tokens tend to carry core semantics and low-probability tokens are more often replaceable phrasing. It uses the model being trained to compute token probabilities online, then masks losses for tokens below a fixed threshold. The remaining high-probability tokens define the supervised target, so one response supplies a selective signal rather than an all-token imitation target.

The paper frames this as avoiding interference rather than generating more answers. A semantic study labels core and trivial tokens in multiple answers with Gemini-3-Pro, then finds their probability distributions differ significantly: the reported mean probability is 0.768 for core tokens and 0.485 for trivial ones, with a hypothesis-test p-value of 1×10⁻⁶. The authors also derive a gradient lower bound showing why low-probability tokens can dominate updates even when they are not the desired semantic signal.

ProFit 假定，对于它研究的逻辑密集任务，高概率参考词元往往携带核心语义，而低概率词元更常是可替换措辞。它用正在训练的模型在线计算词元概率，再屏蔽低于固定阈值的词元损失。剩余高概率词元定义监督目标，因此一条回复提供选择性信号，而不是全词元模仿目标。

论文将此描述为避免干扰，而不是生成更多答案。一项语义研究用 Gemini-3-Pro 标注多个答案中的核心和琐碎词元，再发现二者的概率分布显著不同：报告的核心词元平均概率为 0.768，琐碎词元为 0.485，假设检验 p 值为 1×10⁻⁶。作者还推导梯度下界，说明低概率词元即使不是期望语义信号，也可能主导更新。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a reference sequence, ProFit detaches the model probability at position t and defines a binary mask that retains the cross-entropy term only when that probability exceeds a static threshold τ. The stop-gradient gate prevents the discrete masking rule from being optimized through directly. All retained token losses are averaged over the response, whereas standard SFT applies cross-entropy to every reference token. The method uses current online probabilities and needs neither an external reference model nor multiple reference responses.

The main SFT experiments curate 2,000 high-reward samples from BAAI-InfinityInstruct and train Qwen3, Llama-3.1, and OLMo-2 families. They compare full-token SFT with entropy-based tuning and Dynamic Fine-tuning, and evaluate GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME'24, and IFEval. The paper additionally examines threshold and LoRA-rank behavior, re-fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Instruct models, and initializes GRPO on DeepScaleR from ProFit, standard SFT, or DFT checkpoints.

对于参考序列，ProFit 在位置 t 分离模型概率，并只在该概率超过静态阈值 τ 时保留交叉熵项的二元掩码。停止梯度门避免离散掩码规则被直接通过优化。所有保留词元损失在回复上取平均，而标准监督微调对每个参考词元施加交叉熵。方法使用当前在线概率，既不需要外部参考模型，也不需要多个参考回复。

主监督微调实验从 BAAI-InfinityInstruct 整理 2,000 个高奖励样本，并训练 Qwen3、Llama-3.1 和 OLMo-2 系列。它将全词元监督微调与基于熵的微调和动态微调比较，并评测 GPQA-Diamond、GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME'24 和 IFEval。论文还检查阈值和 LoRA 秩行为，重新微调 Qwen2.5-Instruct 模型，并以 ProFit、标准监督微调或动态微调检查点在 DeepScaleR 上初始化 GRPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Qwen3-4B-Base, ProFit reaches a five-benchmark average of 52.33, compared with 41.39 for standard SFT and 50.30 for Dynamic Fine-tuning. On Qwen3-14B-Base, standard SFT is 1.88 points below the vanilla model's average, whereas ProFit changes that to a 5.64-point gain; on Qwen3-0.6B, ProFit averages 31.49 versus 28.51 for SFT. The threshold ablation also reports that retaining only low-probability tokens performs below standard SFT, while retaining high-probability tokens beats it across the shown thresholds.

The evidence goes beyond base-model SFT. For Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, ProFit reaches 54.88 average versus 54.71 for the original instruction model and 52.88 for standard SFT, although it is not uniformly better at every scale. As an RL initialization, it reaches MATH-500 Avg@4 57.3 and Pass@4 76.4, compared with 53.1 and 70.6 for the baseline. These are reported results on a 2,000-sample, reasoning-oriented setup; they do not prove that masking low-probability tokens preserves semantic value in creative or open-ended generation.

在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，ProFit 的五基准平均分为 52.33，而标准监督微调为 41.39，动态微调为 50.30。在 Qwen3-14B-Base 上，标准监督微调比原始模型平均分低 1.88 点，ProFit 则将其改为提高 5.64 点；在 Qwen3-0.6B 上，ProFit 平均为 31.49，监督微调为 28.51。阈值消融还报告，只保留低概率词元低于标准监督微调，而保留高概率词元在展示的各阈值上超过它。

证据不止于基础模型监督微调。对于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，ProFit 平均为 54.88，原始指令模型为 54.71，标准监督微调为 52.88，尽管它并非在每个规模上都一致更好。作为强化学习初始化，它在 MATH-500 上达到 Avg@4 57.3 和 Pass@4 76.4，基线为 53.1 和 70.6。这些是在 2,000 样本、推理导向设置上的报告结果；它们不证明屏蔽低概率词元会在创造性或开放式生成中保留语义价值。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing curation commonly accepts or rejects an entire instruction-response pair, and existing token objectives may reweight tokens or rely on external reference models. ProFit changes the granularity of the training decision: it uses an online, hard probability gate to suppress part of a retained response. Thus the data record is not discarded; its supervision surface changes at token level according to the current policy's confidence.

The distinctive claim is that high predicted probability can proxy core semantic content in the reported tasks, and that hard masking of the complementary tokens reduces gradient interference. It is not a general theorem that probability equals importance. The semantic annotation, threshold ablation, and comparison with entropy and DFT are necessary parts of the contribution because they test whether the particular direction of masking—not merely token weighting—accounts for the reported gains.

既有整理通常接受或拒绝整条指令—回复对，既有词元目标也可能重加权词元或依赖外部参考模型。ProFit 改变训练决策的粒度：它使用在线的硬概率门来抑制已保留回复的一部分。因此，数据记录没有被丢弃；它的监督表面按照当前策略的置信度在词元级改变。

独特主张是，在报告任务中，高预测概率能代理核心语义内容，而屏蔽其余词元可减少梯度干扰。这不是概率等于重要性的普遍定理。语义标注、阈值消融以及与熵和动态微调的比较是贡献的必要部分，因为它们检验所报告收益是否由特定的屏蔽方向而非任意词元加权造成。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors restrict their central assumption to logic-intensive reasoning and mathematics: in creative generation, low-probability tokens may carry valuable stylistic diversity rather than disposable expression. The fixed threshold is shared by all samples, so it cannot adapt to instance difficulty or a model's changing calibration. The semantic analysis uses a Gemini-3-Pro judge, while the training method itself uses model probabilities; neither establishes a universal ground truth of token importance. Code is publicly linked, but the paper does not release a new standalone training dataset, and its curated 2,000-sample slice and upstream InfinityInstruct terms must be reconstructed and checked before reuse.

作者将核心假设限制于逻辑密集的推理和数学：在创造性生成中，低概率词元可能携带有价值的风格多样性，而非可丢弃表达。固定阈值对全部样本共用，因而不能适应样本难度或模型变化的校准。语义分析使用 Gemini-3-Pro 评判器，而训练方法本身使用模型概率；二者都不能建立词元重要性的普遍真值。代码已公开链接，但论文没有发布新的独立训练数据集，其整理的 2,000 样本切片和上游 InfinityInstruct 条款必须在复用前重建并核验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ProFit when SFT has single-reference responses in a reasoning-oriented domain and token-level masking can be implemented in the training loss. Log the base model, threshold, retained-token rate, source sample, and full-token control; then compare task accuracy, instruction following, response length, and failure patterns rather than only average loss. Do not apply the low-probability rule untested to creative writing, multilingual generation, or safety-critical tasks, because the method deliberately removes expression diversity and its reported semantics assumption may fail there.
当监督微调具有推理导向领域的单参考回复，且训练损失可以实现词元级掩码时，可使用 ProFit。应记录基础模型、阈值、保留词元比例、来源样本和全词元对照，再比较任务准确率、指令遵循、回复长度和失败模式，而非只比较平均损失。不要未经测试地把低概率规则应用到创意写作、多语生成或安全关键任务，因为该方法刻意移除了表达多样性，且其报告的语义假设可能失效。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important distinction is between token confidence as a training gate and token confidence as a verifier. ProFit does not establish that a high-probability token is correct; it argues that, within a correct reference in its studied regime, high-probability tokens are often the more stable semantic anchors for SFT. The most useful replication checks are the semantic-label analysis, fraction of tokens retained at each threshold, low-probability-only control, and whether a masked SFT initialization helps or harms the next training consumer such as GRPO.
重要区别是把词元置信度用作训练门，而不是用作验证器。ProFit 不证明高概率词元正确；它认为在研究情形中的正确参考内，高概率词元常是更稳定的监督微调语义锚点。最有用的复现检查是语义标签分析、各阈值的词元保留比例、仅低概率词元的对照，以及掩码监督微调初始化是否帮助或损害 GRPO 等下一训练消费者。
